issues.legal_issue: A tenant-protection rule barring recovery of possession applies to a pending possession suit when the rule becomes applicable to the area before the decree is passed.
material_facts: The tenant’s fixed-term lease expired, and the landlord then filed a suit to recover possession.
While the suit was pending, a notification made the relevant part of the rent-control law applicable to the area where the premises were situated.
The tenant remained in possession after the lease ended and expressed readiness and willingness to pay rent; the Court found that the tenant fulfilled the conditions for protection.
issues.conclusion: The possession restriction applied to the pending suit. Because the tenant fulfilled its conditions, the landlord was not entitled to a decree for possession; the appeal was allowed and the lower courts’ decisions were set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 12(1) of the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947, a landlord is not entitled to recover possession while the tenant pays, or is ready and willing to pay, standard rent and permitted increases and observes the tenancy conditions consistent with the Act. The Act’s definition of tenant includes a person who remains in possession after the lease ends. The point at which section 12(1) operates is when a decree for possession would be passed, so it applies to suits pending when the relevant part of the Act becomes applicable as well as to later suits. Nilkanth Ramachandra v. Rasiklal and Chandrasingh Manibhai v. Surjit Lal Sadhamal Chhabda concerned subsections (2) and (3), not subsection (1), and therefore did not determine this issue.

rule.if: pending_possession_suit and rent_protection_became_applicable and tenant_remained_after_lease and tenant_ready_and_willing_to_pay and tenant_observed_tenancy_conditions

predicates.pending_possession_suit: A landlord had brought a suit to recover premises, and the suit remained pending when the court had to decide whether to decree possession.
predicates.rent_protection_became_applicable: A rent-protection rule became applicable to the area where the premises were situated while the possession suit was pending.
predicates.tenant_remained_after_lease: The tenant continued in possession after the lease had ended.
predicates.tenant_ready_and_willing_to_pay: The tenant showed readiness and willingness to pay the rent and permitted increases due.
predicates.tenant_observed_tenancy_conditions: The tenant observed and performed the tenancy conditions consistent with the applicable rent-protection rule.

issues.definition: When a possession suit is pending, rent protection becomes applicable, and the tenant remains after the lease while meeting the payment and tenancy-condition requirements, the landlord is not entitled to a possession decree.
